secondaryDevelopmentSplit.sourceSubset: the 128 V109 observed model-blind holdback records
secondaryDevelopmentSplit.claimBoundary: prospectively split secondary development analysis; not an independent new model or protected-test result

policies.character_ngram_retrieval: exact V106 character TF-IDF method with thresholds recalibrated only on V110 calibration
policies.direct_llm: exact expanded V109 prediction and confidence
policies.calibrated_abstention: direct LLM prediction unless confidence is below the selected threshold, otherwise zero-confidence ABSTAIN
policies.deterministic_novelty_gate: replace any direct LLM decision with the retrieval NOVEL decision whenever calibrated retrieval selects NOVEL; otherwise retain direct LLM
policies.llm_plus_validation: use calibrated retrieval NOVEL decisions; otherwise accept only exact LLM/retrieval agreement and zero-confidence ABSTAIN on disagreement
policies.oracle: exact hidden typed truth for scoring only

calibratedAbstention.selectionObjective: minimum calibration mean regret; ties use minimum false-known acceptance, maximum exact accuracy, then smallest threshold

retrievalCalibration.selectionObjective: minimum calibration mean regret; ties use maximum exact accuracy, minimum false-known acceptance, then lexicographically smallest thresholds

decisionRule.ifEveryPrimaryAndIntegrityGatePasses: freeze development result and separately preregister one identical deterministic layer for protected-test evaluation
decisionRule.ifAnyPrimaryGateFails: freeze negative development result; do not access protected test or proceed to schema induction
